'''Bator Bai''' was an [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Bator Bai system/Legends|Bator Bai system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was linked by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Kalgo system/Legends|Kalgo]] and [[Suliana system/Legends|Suliana systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Bator Bai featured ice cliffs and [[Cave/Legends|caverns]], the remarkable clarity of which it was known for. Like the other worlds in the Senex-Juvex, it was under the control of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] that ruled there.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bator Bai was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />
